label: Left hemisphere ADsig Mayo cortical thickness (mm) - Longitudinal - Insight46 phase 2
meta_rows: Left hemisphere ADsig Mayo cortical thickness (mm) - Longitudinal - Insight46 phase 2

Insight46 phase 2 cortical thickness assessed using Freesurfer's longitudinal stream in two composite regions of interest: one comprised of middle temporal, inferior temporal, entorhinal and fusiform areas (ADsig Mayo); and one consisting of parahippocampal, inferior temporal, entorhinal, temporal pole, precuneus, supramarginal, superior and inferior parietal, superior frontal, parsopercularis, parstriangularis and parsorbitalis areas (ADsig Harvard). Also measured in phase 1 - see library file I46_Cortical_thickness.
